rules.message: an unresolved merge conflict marker was committed
rules.fix: resolve the conflict and delete the <<<<<<< / >>>>>>> lines

rules.message: a private key is in the repository
rules.fix: remove it, rotate the key, and load it from a secret store or an untracked env file (.env is gitignored; GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON goes there)

rules.message: a tagged debug line from /stack-agent:debug is still in the code
rules.fix: delete every line tagged [DEBUG-...] (grep for the tag); keep the regression test instead

rules.message: a "use client" component must not import server code (database, auth, secrets from lib/env); it leaks into the browser bundle or breaks the build
rules.fix: call the API with apps/web/src/components/client/fetch.ts, or move a pure helper into @app/core (packages/core/src, not src/server)

rules.message: server code opens a connection without the SSRF guard, so a monitored site (or a redirect it returns) could reach hosts inside the LAN
rules.fix: use fetchBytesGuarded (guarded-fetch.ts) or runCheck (http-check.ts); for a raw socket pass lookup: createGuardedLookup() or check isBlockedIp first, as security-scan.ts and probe.ts do; browsers go through startGuardedProxy (egress-proxy.ts)
